newsitem.title: USA: AOL in pacts with Internet Liquidators.
newsitem.headline: AOL in pacts with Internet Liquidators.

text.p: America Online Inc Wednesday said it will enter into a partnership with Internet Liquidators International Inc, in which revenue from Internet Liquidators International's auction platforms, online mall and other transaction-based content will be shared with AOL.

The two companies also announced that AOL has taken a minority equity interest in Toronto-based Internet Liquidators, which provides auctions and an online shopping mall in which customers can bid on and purchase items.

Under the agreement, AOL will provide a direct link for its members to reach the Internet Liquidators electronic commerce site on the World Wide Web and provide marketing support, promotions and product offerings to its customers.
